name: Nau'ur-class yacht
description: The Nau'ur-class yacht, also commonly known as the Kalevalan star yacht or just Kalevalan, was a type of custom-order luxurious yacht manufactured by Kalevala Spaceworks. Notable Nau'ur-class yachts included the First Light, owned by Dryden Vos, a high ranking member of the criminal Crimson Dawn syndicate, and the Coronet, owned by Duchess Satine Kryze of Mandalore. Several Kalevalan yachts were part of the Dawn Fleet.

data.name: Nau'ur-class yacht

1 starboard retractable turret-mounted quad laser cannon
